_howTo: Add an adventure by copying one object in `hikes` and editing it. Pins on the map are placed automatically from elevationGain. Photos go in /public/images (e.g. "images/my-hike.webp"); leave src empty for an illustrated placeholder. Distance/elevation values are approximate — replace them with your own Strava numbers.
